name: docs-hygiene
description: Documentation-hygiene toolkit: compress (trim markdown with a semantic-diff check), audit-noise (classify markdown noise), extract-ssot (deduplicate into a single source of truth), audit-encapsulation (citations into skill-private files), rename-references (stale references after renames), audit-derivability (does a doc earn its existence), audit-progressive-disclosure (load tiers), write-for-agents and write-for-humans (authoring). Setup checks markdownlint-cli2.
